author: MellowFungus
quote: The expansion is incredibly underwhelming. I find myself unable to go through the story for extended gaming sessions before needing to switch to something else. The writing and setting are boring, and you're forced to interact with one of Squares worst characters Wuk Lamat. The Graphics update is extremely underwhelming and the overall direction isn't filling me with confidence. The Glamour's are just getting worse and more boring and the combat design is starting to get really REALLY stale. I just can't believe how badly they messed up this expansion.
